reason: Driven in chromium at ?state=partial, 1440/1280/768/390, light and dark. The quote is exact (lately.html:870) and every load-bearing claim built on it is wrong. (1) The consequence's headline claim - 'it is the only place on this surface where the product talks about itself' - is false in the very state it was raised against. The same frame carries 'Counted at the moment each job reached a done column.' (hero note, lately.html:823), the whole third movement in that register ('Nothing was written down about how much was open in earlier weeks', 'nothing keeps a record of it yet', 'That would be a change in Notes'), the ghost caption ('Once open work starts being counted each week, it fills in after about a month.'), and a coverage footer that prints TASKS ANSWERED / TIMELINE DID NOT ANSWER / LAB COUNTS AND AGES ARE LAB-AUTHORED / BOUND WORKSPACE, OWNER, READING DATE AND THE 9. A product that reports on its own reading is this surface's register, and the movement that carries it is a protected object. The note is inside that register, not an outlier in it. (2) 'It tells them nothing they can act on' fails on measurement. In the partial KPI row the '-' card sits at x=646 and a genuine '0 | are waiting on something else' card sits at x=1086 - a real zero and a real unavailable, same row, same type ramp, 440px apart. 'It does not fall back to zero' is the only sentence on the visible surface that separates them, and separating them is the literal wording of the protected honest-degradation contract ('A reader can never mistake "we don't know" for "it's zero"'). The card's own furniture says '-' and 'NOT AVAILABLE'; neither says 'not zero'. (3) The class citation is misapplied. refusals-written-in-the-studio-vocabulary (r1) was engineering nouns and verbs - 'snapshot writer', 'callers', 'date recorder', 'accrues', 'three periods' - plus a 'we' that appeared nowhere else; lessons.md scopes the paid class as 'The studio's private vocabulary in the accessibility tree. Internal names are not product names.' No internal name appears here, and nothing in the accessibility tree is touched: the card's name is 'Jobs past the day they were due: not available, because Timeline did not answer', which is plain. 'Card' is the ordinary English word for the object the reader is looking at, not a component name leaked from source. The class has not regressed; a different sentence in the same register was found and called by the old name. (4) The fix would make the work worse and commits the defect it names. 'Everything else on this page was read normally' is itself the product narrating its own reading, so it does not cure the stated problem; 'read normally' is further from the owner's language than 'does not fall back to zero' ('normally' against what norm?); it duplicates the coverage footer, which already prints TASKS ANSWERED and NOTES ANSWERED, FOR YOU four hundred pixels below; and it deletes the only foreclosure of the zero-misreading in a row that visibly contains a zero. It is billed as 'the owner's next fact' and is not a fact about her venue at all. (5) Severity. The seat classed this refinement, which the brief defines as 'nothing is wrong', and this round's instruction is explicit that a refinement is not to be raised to have raised something. The cost is one wrapped line at 1280/1440 (note is 3 lines, 79px) and two at 390 (5 lines, 125px) - measured, not asserted.
sharpenedFix: No change is required and none should be made on a frozen surface. If a future round wants the sentence tightened, the only defensible edit keeps the foreclosure and drops the layout commentary and the policy defence, naming what the reader sees rather than the component: 'Timeline did not answer this reading, so nothing here knows a due date. The dash above is not a zero.' That is one clause shorter, removes 'the card' and 'keeps its place', and preserves the one thing the second sentence is actually for.
breaks: Taking the seat's fix as written breaks the honest-degradation contract's only visible statement in the state that exercises it, in a row that simultaneously displays a real 0, and it adds a third printing of source status already carried by the coverage footer and the card's accessible name. If any edit to this note lands, re-measure: the note's line count and height at 390/768/1280/1440 in both grounds (currently 5/3/3/3 lines, 125/79/79/79px, ink-2 #3f3f46 light, ink-5 #d4d4d8 dark), the gap-line spacing between the KPI row and the strip card, and the interaction-check assertion at line 286 that requires 'Timeline did not answer' to survive in the coverage strip.
